name: HyperliquidX 0.1.3
body:
# HyperliquidX 0.1.3

This patch improves the order book, recent trades, market notifications and wallet visibility.

- Added order book price grouping and a switch between token and quote-currency units for Size and Total. Quote totals use each level's price, and changing grouping clears stale quotes while preserving the chart.
- Unified order book and Recent trades price formatting so prices retain trailing zeros at the displayed precision.
- Added Hyperliquid Explorer links for recent trades with valid transaction hashes, token labels for trade sizes, and improved column alignment.
- Improved large-trade notifications with compact amounts, buy/sell indicators and quantity-weighted average prices for grouped trades. Initial snapshots and replayed trades remain quiet.
- Show the currently selected wallet in the top-right account button as the first six and last four address characters; switching wallets updates the label.
- Fixed SwiftLint issues required by the native release build.

The macOS installer supports Apple Silicon and Intel. This release uses the existing ad-hoc signing policy and is not Apple notarized.
